free_resources.title: Les bienfaits du Yoga Iyengar
free_resources.description: An article in French from the centre on what regular Iyengar practice develops: mobility, stability, balance, body awareness, steady attention and calmer breathing, with props used to adapt each pose. It stresses patience and regular practice and makes no medical promises.

flags: Les bienfaits du Yoga Iyengar: the current article no longer leads with back problems; it mentions reducing stress once and has its own section saying Iyengar yoga is not presented as a medical treatment and does not replace medical advice or follow-up. Kept under the new rule. Article in French.
